title: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents in complex, stochastic environments must contend with dynamics that can exceed their world models' predictive capacity and randomness that obscure the consequences of their actions. We hypothesize that, compared to imagining entirely new trajectories in such complex environments, it can be easier to transform observed trajectories with alternative actions. Counterfactual world models condition on observations to predict alternative outcomes under the same underlying environmental randomness, using experience as a reference for predicting action-dependent changes. We present a policy gradient estimator, REINFORCE Look Back (RLB), that uses counterfactual returns as baselines to distinguish action effects from environmental luck, and prove conditions for unbiasedness and variance reduction. translated_title: 回顾：基于反事实世界模型的强化学习
translated_abstract: 复杂随机环境中的智能体必须应对可能超出其世界模型预测能力的环境动力学，以及掩盖其动作真实后果的随机性。我们假设，与在这种复杂环境中凭空想象全新轨迹相比，用替代动作对已观测到的轨迹进行变换可能更容易。反事实世界模型以观测为条件，在相同的环境随机性下预测替代动作的结果，利用已有经验作为参考来预测动作相关的变化。我们提出了一种策略梯度估计器——REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），它使用反事实回报作为基线，以区分动作效应与环境运气，并证明了其无偏性和方差缩减的条件。在环境演化比动作引起的变化更难预测的场景中，我们表明反事实世界模型更容易学习（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出基于反事实世界模型的策略梯度估计器REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），通过将观测轨迹变换为替代动作的结果、并以反事实回报作为基线来区分动作效应与环境运气、降低梯度估计方差，从而提升复杂随机环境中的强化学习效果。
en_tdlr: We propose REINFORCE Look Back (RLB), a policy gradient estimator that leverages counterfactual world models to transform observed trajectories under alternative actions, using counterfactual returns as baselines to distinguish action effects from environmental luck and reduce variance in reinforcement learning.
